text:
deploy-bot: Deploy completed to prod (release=2026-03-21/2.18.0). kicking off post-deploy checks: smoke, prefill-sampler, kvprobe.

alex: seeing a gradual p95 increase on the prefill sampler for /v1/generate-route since 02:10 UTC. not an immediate 5xx, more tail latency.

maria: same. queue depth for sampler creeping up. p95 went from ~420ms -> ~900ms over ~15m. p99 hitting ~2s.

sre-janet: do we have the histogram or a short metric dump? want to confirm it's sampler backpressure, not downstream.

alex: pasted snippet from metrics stream:
```
prefill_sampler.queue_depth: 12 -> 48
prefill_sampler.p95_ms: 420 -> 905
prefill_sampler.p99_ms: 900 -> 2100
prefill_sampler.retries: small uptick
```

runtime-lee: rolled a small allocator/lock tweak in this release that affects batch assembly. sounds consistent with contention in the prefill path.

oncall: are clients seeing errors (429/503) or just slower responses?

maria: mostly slower TTFB and a handful of client timeouts (~5s) hitting some internal dashboards. not widespread 5xx yet.

pm-ryan: this is user-impacting for a few customers on heavy prefill flows. we should be conservative.

sre-janet: proposal: pause automated canary progression and pin the route to the previous stable variant while we mitigate. pining is quicker than rollback for the whole release.

alex: agreed. pin command for ops: `redwoodctl routing pin --route /v1/generate-route --version v2.17.8 --duration 15m`

runtime-lee: executing pin now. also will push a quick config flip to reduce sampler concurrency from 16 -> 8 and enable stricter backpressure to avoid queue pileup.

oncall: monitoring watch: keep eye on prefill_sampler.p95_ms and queue_depth. trigger unpin if p95 < 500ms and queue_depth < 20 for 5 continuous minutes.

maria: started a tiny rollback candidate branch (revert-lock-tweak) in case config flip doesn't help.

sre-janet: created a short incident thread and assigned sev-low owners: alex, runtime-lee, maria. adding logs/trace links.

pm-ryan: please add a note in release notes stating we pinned the generate route due to sampler latency spike and that a fix is in progress. will notify affected customers proactively.

alex: pin applied, metrics look like they're plateauing. queue depth down to ~22 after ~2 mins. p95 trending down from 900 -> 540ms.

runtime-lee: config change rolled. sampler concurrency 8, backpressure enabled. expect further improvement in next minute.

oncall: keeping 15m hold. if stable, we unpin and allow rollout to continue. if not, escalate to rollback of full release.

maria: filing a follow-up PR with the revert and test coverage for batch assembly path. will link to incident.

sre-janet: thanks team — good call to pin quickly. will capture timeline and next steps in the incident doc. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks all. will update when we reach stable window or if we need to flip to rollback.
